reserveReview.rationale: Fresh capture 2026-07-31 at IOTA checkpoint 172877784 (timestamp 2026-07-30 23:13:50 UTC) reads all four live shared Virtue vaults and the shared Stability Pool. Vault balances were 669,463.125762316 IOTA, 25,940,400.259379815 stIOTA, 57,017.073454695 vIOTA, and 0.0149549784 iBTC; VUSD debt supplies were 14,725.933422, 538,673.551046, 1,138.959800, and 732.517975 respectively. Current Swirl and TokenLabs NativePool objects plus cert::Metadata objects give exchange rates 1.1466223329 IOTA/stIOTA and 1.0500262411 IOTA/vIOTA. Pyth Hermes prices published 2026-07-30 23:16:58 UTC were $0.03252683 IOTA/USD and $64,876.40913043 BTC/USD. The resulting collateral values are approximately $21,775.51, $967,472.90, $1,947.36, and $970.23, normalized to 2.19%, 97.51%, 0.20%, and 0.10% (100.00% total). The shared Stability Pool read separately showed 176,231.229596 VUSD across 190 positions. The composition is fully identified at the capture point; no independent reserve attestation or legal custody assurance is published.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current on-chain branch balances and NativePool exchange rates, valued with the exact Pyth feeds consumed by Virtue's deployed oracle rules and cross-checked against Virtue's CDP collateral documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unidentified direct collateral or tracked-stablecoin dependency remains at the 2026-07-31 checkpoint capture; all four slices are external cryptoasset identities rather than Pharos-tracked stablecoins. Independent reserve assurance, legal segregation, and guaranteed liquidation liquidity are not disclosed and are recorded in custodyProfile rather than as an unidentified composition slice.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The fresh capture shows collateral in four shared protocol vault objects and VUSD in one shared Stability Pool (190 positions), so on-chain custody is omnibus at the protocol/branch level rather than an identified bank or segregated account. The package is immutable but an AdminCap gates supply limits and module versions, and liquidations run through a configured executor. No independent reserve attestation, legal segregation statement, bankruptcy-remoteness opinion, rehypothecation policy, or other assurance report covering the current collateral was found in the reviewed issuer documentation, audit, or on-chain sources; latest assurance scope is therefore unavailable.
